title: One failed request
caption: Maya matches the request trace. The old process exited before it finished replying.
alt: Close view past Maya's dark bob and round glasses. Her green-sleeved hand points at a monitor containing three illustrated evidence tracks: an accepted request, an interrupted response and an error. Slate screen light contrasts with the warm wooden desk.

labels.title: ALB returns 502
labels.detail: The same request loses its reply.

technicalNote: Fictional stitched investigation view, not native output from any tool. r-17 is a display alias for a trace matched between the ALB record and application logging of X-Amzn-Trace-Id. The old target address, request timing, process lifetime and known immediate-exit handler explain the interrupted response. SIGTERM is process-level, not a per-request Kubernetes event. A healthy new pod does not take over an already accepted request. A 502 does not establish whether the order committed.
